answer: New keys are rationed by a uniform-price sale. A public bridge takes 12 minutes of sealed bids, then fills a fixed oasis of 48 seats. Winners lock P, the 48th-highest bid, for 18 epochs; a second bid from the same funding path is dropped. Losers recover the bid minus 35 POA. A rush lifts P by that delta, so 200 farm bids still win at most 48 and pay the higher P. One honest try locks about 2,260 POA, or 35 POA on a miss; four sales still tie up ~9,040 POA plus fees, vs ~150 POA. A whale could clear the oasis; cap one win per two-hop path and reserve 8 seats for a random sub-median draw.
